statement: At the pinned SDL revision, SDL_hidapi_ps4.c manages controller HID input and output effect fields, including audio-labeled output levels, but does not enumerate an ALSA card or PipeWire node or bind a joystick to an SDL audio-device identifier. This absence is limited to the inspected PS4 HIDAPI driver; it does not exclude association by other SDL subsystems or applications.

applicability.scope: SDL PS4 HIDAPI driver only (audio-labeled output fields ~109-123; output formatting ~656-677 and ~924-973); complete file searched for SDL_Audio references.
